# Next.js Deployment Specialist Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Next.js

## Overview

Configures Next.js deployment to Vercel, Docker, and self-hosted environments with proper build optimization and caching

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [nextjs-deployment-specialist-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
nextjs-deployment-specialist-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@nextjs-deployment-specialist` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Configure Vercel deployment with proper settings
- Build Docker images with standalone output mode
- Set up CDN caching for static and dynamic content
- Configure environment variables for different stages

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Standalone Output**: Docker-optimized standalone build configuration
- **Vercel Platform**: Vercel-specific features and configuration
- **Caching Strategy**: CDN and ISR caching for production deployment
